text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: What a Googlebot request passes through on Vercel
Five checkpoints in the order a request meets them, as documented in September 2026

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 01 HOSTNAME

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Which hostname did Googlebot request?
Your custom domain, the project.vercel.app
alias, a preview URL or a branch domain.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: GOOGLEBOT GETS
The alias serves the same production pages
until a host-scoped redirect sends it to
your domain with a 308.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 02 DEPLOYMENT PROTECTION

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Is the URL behind a Vercel login?
New projects start at Standard: previews and
generated URLs locked, production domains open.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: GOOGLEBOT GETS
All Deployments with Vercel Authentication:
a login redirect on every URL, production
included. Free on every plan since 9 Sep 2026.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 03 FIREWALL

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Does a firewall rule challenge it?
Attack Mode and the bot protection ruleset
pass verified bots such as Googlebot.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: GOOGLEBOT GETS
Your page, unless a custom challenge rule
matches it: Vercel documents no bot pass
for the rules you write yourself.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 04 RESPONSE HEADERS

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Does Vercel add X-Robots-Tag: noindex?
Only on previews and on outdated
production deployments.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: GOOGLEBOT GETS
Current production: no noindex header.
A branch with its own custom domain:
none either, unless you add one.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 05 HTML

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: What does your framework print?
The robots meta tag and the canonical,
written into the HTML your build ships.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: GOOGLEBOT GETS
A noindex here stops rendering and indexing.
Listing the page in a sitemap does not undo it.
